<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914115_theRebbe_704" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914115_theRebbe_704__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that even a completely righteous person has a sense of self in their service, which is like pointing a finger before the king, requiring repentance of "turn from evil."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood based on the statement of our sages, of blessed memory:</t>
    <t s="2">"One who points with a finger before the king, etc."</t>
    <t s="3">For before the king, one must be in a state of utter self-nullification, and when one points with a finger before the king, he appears as an existence before the king.</t>
    <t s="4">From this it is understood</t>
    <t s="5">that even when one serves Havayah, but his service is in the manner of existence,</t>
    <t s="6">it is comparable to one who points with a finger before the king, heaven forbid.</t>
    <t s="7">And based on this, it will be understood that even in completely righteous individuals there must be</t>
    <t s="8">(also)</t>
    <t s="9">the matter of repentance of "turn from evil,"</t>
    <t s="10">for since even when he is a completely righteous person, serving G-d with fear and love in delights, he is not utterly nullified in existence; rather, he is a separate entity, one who fears Him and loves Him</t>
    <t s="11">(there is one who loves and there is one who fears),</t>
    <t s="12">as explained in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="13">behold, the acceptance of the yoke of the kingdom of heaven is not in perfect completeness,</t>
    <t s="14">and relative to his level, it is like a casting off of the yoke.</t>
    <t s="15">Therefore, even in a completely righteous person, there must be the repentance of "turn from evil."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the repentance for the sin of the level of "Israel" (one who loves) is achieved through the revelation of the name Havayah, which brings about nullification of existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is "Return, O Israel, unto Havayah your G-d, for you have stumbled in your iniquity,"</t>
    <t s="1">that the repentance for the stumbling in the sin that is at the level of Israel</t>
    <t s="2">(there is one who loves)</t>
    <t s="3">is that Havayah will be your G-d.</t>
    <t s="4">For in order to negate the matter of yeshut (selfhood),</t>
    <t s="5">(there is one who loves)</t>
    <t s="6">it is specifically through the revelation of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="7">For regarding the name Elokim,</t>
    <t s="8">since coming into being from the name Elokim is in a manner of enclothement</t>
    <t s="9">("In the beginning, Elokim created"),</t>
    <t s="10">the creations that come into being from it occupy space,</t>
    <t s="11">and their nullification is only the nullification of the yesh (the existent entity),</t>
    <t s="12">but not so regarding the name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="13">for coming into being from it is in a manner of "incidentally"</t>
    <t s="14">("They shall praise the name of Havayah, for He commanded and they were created"),</t>
    <t s="15">the creations do not occupy space,</t>
    <t s="16">[they are] nullified in existence.</t>
    <t s="17">And this is that the repentance for "you have stumbled in your iniquity" that is at the level of Israel,</t>
    <t s="18">there is one who loves,</t>
    <t s="19">is that "Havayah will be your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="20">for by means of the revelation of Havayah shining within him,</t>
    <t s="21">and to the extent that this</t>
    <t s="22">(Havayah)</t>
    <t s="23">becomes "your G-d," your power and your life-force,</t>
    <t s="24">he comes to nullification in existence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that true repentance must reach the level where Havayah itself is considered Elokim and a contraction relative to the Essence of the Ein Sof, which is beyond Havayah, bringing about ultimate nullification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, it is explained in Likkutei Torah</t>
    <t s="2">that the explanation of "Return, O Israel, unto Havayah your G-d" is that the repentance must be until Havayah is only the aspect of Elokim and a contraction relative to the Essence of the Ein Sof, which is above Havayah.</t>
    <t s="3">And it is similar to the explanation of "Havayah is the Elokim"</t>
    <t s="4">that is said at the Neilah service of Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="5">that Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="6">(Havayah)</t>
    <t s="7">when it ascends to Atik, is considered like Elokim.</t>
    <t s="8">And this will be understood based on what is known,</t>
    <t s="9">that even regarding the name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="10">since it is a source for coming into being,</t>
    <t s="11">for Havayah is a term meaning "He brings into being"</t>
    <t s="12">(except that the coming into being is in a manner of "incidentally"),</t>
    <t s="13">necessarily there is some occupation of space for the creations,</t>
    <t s="14">and the true nullification is specifically regarding the Essence of the Ein Sof, which is above Havayah, which is not in the category of a source for worlds.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is that the repentance for "you have stumbled in your iniquity"</t>
    <t s="16">(there is one who loves)</t>
    <t s="17">is "unto Havayah your G-d"</t>
    <t s="18">(according to the explanation in Likkutei Torah)</t>
    <t s="19">that Havayah is Elokim and a contraction relative to the Essence of the Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="20">for through the revelation of the Essence of the Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="21">[Atik,</t>
    <t s="22">which is separate, removed, and distinct from the existence of the worlds],</t>
    <t s="23">they arrive at the ultimate nullification.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
